This enemy has a higher All-Attribute RES.
This enemy has the Rage Feather ability and three weaknesses. After remaining in combat for a period of time, Kronablight enters the Rage Feather state, greatly enhancing its ATK.
Weakness I: A successful Counterattack can damage its crest and wings, weakening its attacks and reducing the number of ranged projectiles.
Weakness II: Tune Break can remove its Rage Feather state and reduce its ranged projectiles.
Special Weakness: When Kronablight is under Tune Rupture - Shifting, hitting it with Tune Break will greatly reduce its All-Attribute RES. A powerful raptor-like Exoswarm, mimicking an ancient predator known as Kronaclaw.
In the distant past, these raptors once circled the skies of Lahai-Roi, their dominion unchallenged since the First Epoch.
Legend holds that the Kronaclaw was a creation of Sol, sharing the divine sight of the Eye of Sol and beholding all that lay above and below Lahai-Roi.
But as magnetic poles shifted and the landscape was reshaped, the Kronaclaw species had faded into near extinction. Their place was eventually taken by Kronablight, an Exoswarm born of the Exostrider.|Description When Discovered}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Kronablight |zhs = 冠顶械隼 |zht = 冠頂械隼 |ja = メカファルコン |ko = 크로나블라이트 |fr = Fléauronne |de = Kronafäule |es = Kronalcón |th = Kronablight }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.1}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
